mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 may theoretically enhance the blood pressure-lowering effects of candesartan through additive vasodilatory properties, and statins (often co-prescribed with ARBs) deplete CoQ10 levels which CoQ10 supplementation can replenish.
action: Monitor blood pressure when initiating or adjusting CoQ10 supplementation; no dose adjustment typically needed but counseling on potential additive hypotensive effects is recommended.
